onboarding-user-comment.text: Your own comments: leave yourself a quick note while reviewing a draft.
onboarding-user-comment.quote: Your own comments stay editable — leave yourself a review note and revise it later.

onboarding-agent-comment.text: The agent's comments are labelled as its own, so you always know who wrote what.
onboarding-agent-comment.quote: The agent can leave comments too, and its own are labelled as its own.
